## About
Arkar Yan builds practical web and mobile products, AI features, developer tools, and software for clients. He is based in Yangon, Myanmar, and has been building independently since 2014. The portfolio does not publish unverified usage, student, client, or project-count metrics.

## Experience
- 2024 — Present: Programming Instructor & Project Manager, YHA Computer (Yangon, Myanmar). Teaches full-stack web and mobile frameworks and leads development projects.
- 2022 — 2024: Founder, Power Agriculture Myanmar. Agricultural brand, supply-chain, packaging, and distribution work.
- 2020 — Present: Cybersecurity Consultant, Myanmar Cyber Ghost.
- 2019 — Present: Founder & CEO, k Square.
- 2014 — Present: Independent Software Developer, Freelance.

## Services
- Product engineering: product discovery, design, implementation, responsive web/mobile interfaces, APIs, databases, and deployment.
- Web and mobile applications: React, Laravel, Inertia.js, Flutter, and native Android projects.
- AI and automation: Gemini AI integrations, Wasmtime-based code sandboxing, routing, recommendation, and voice-alert features.
- Teaching and mentoring: full-stack web/mobile instruction, code reviews, debugging, and cybersecurity fundamentals.

## Selected projects
- ZAP Lang — Programming language and developer tool with a Rust runtime, dynamic typing, and a self-hosting compiler toolchain. Live: https://zap-lang.hidecard1500.workers.dev/ · Source: https://github.com/hidecard/zap · VS Code Marketplace: https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=ArkarYan.zap-language-support

- YBS AI — Yangon bus-route guide with offline use, NFC card reading, BFS routing, and Burmese voice alerts. Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=net.arkaryan.ybs_ai · Route data: https://github.com/hidecard/yangon-ybs-guide · App source: https://github.com/hidecard/YBS-AI-App

- MM Career AI — Burmese-first career guidance platform with skills assessment, career matching, learning roadmaps, job suggestions, interview preparation, resume builder, and AI mentor. Live: https://mm-career-ai.vercel.app/ · Source: https://github.com/hidecard/mm-career-ai · Case study: https://arkaryan.net/projects/mm-career-ai/

- CSS-Labs Playground — Flexbox and Grid learning playground with live preview and code generation. Live: https://css-labs.vercel.app/
